description: Documented causes of line-item gaps in fund flow_detail blocks (fund total minus captured lines). Dashboard-owned annotation, not ledger data. An entry is shown only while the fund's gap for that year equals `gap` exactly; once the extractor captures the lines, or the gap changes, the entry stops applying and the page falls back to the generic note. Values read from the ACFR page cited and confirmed in `pdftotext -layout` output.

resolved.resolved_in: af21d8cdb1a577cdff04cdeda3f1a73d28199286 (PR #13), from the patches proposed in 2450d7a (PR #11)
resolved.cause: On the governmental funds statement the row 'Community development and housing' wraps onto two lines, so its values sat on a line labeled 'and housing', which the extractor's expenditure list did not include; the General Fund's 'TRAN issuance costs' row was also not in the list.
resolved.note: The same correction added the 'Inception of leases and subscriptions' other-financing-source lines (011 $18,156,996; ACFR-grants $19,381) that the ACFR reports against this capital activity. Those are non-cash financing, not revenue; the dashboard lists them separately and never adds them to revenue.
